changelog: New voice command "copy last word" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ শব্দ কপি করো" in Bengali) and the word right before the cursor is copied to the clipboard in one step, so you can paste it anywhere without the two-step "select last word" + "copy". It is the one-segment version of v14.5's select. The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 54 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
